research_contract.question: How can persistent project owners complete authorized work while preserving intent, recovery and necessary human control?
source_scopes: Public project ownership and handoff contracts
Authorized owner delivery, recovery and review evidence
research_contract.decision_to_change: Choose ownership, routing and handoff practices that reduce avoidable intervention without losing accountability.
success_criteria: An owner reaches the real acceptance gate with current source, scope and evidence available to a successor.
Distinguish the owner's report, independent acceptance and actual release of write authority.
falsifiers: Reduced coordination produces more scope errors, lost corrections, duplicate writers or rejected outcomes.
A successor can locate handoff files but cannot recover the actual evidence and next action.
evidence_gaps: A handoff-file count or quiet coordinator does not establish autonomous delivery or reliable succession.
watch_triggers: New owner-approved outcome or counterexample changes the decision evidence.
The relevant source, operating constraint or acceptance boundary materially changes.
research_contract.answer_shape: One observed ownership and recovery case with the acceptance boundary, intervention/rework accounting and reusable limits.
research_contract.refresh_policy: Review when relevant owner evidence or decision conditions change; registration starts no collector, benchmark, scheduler or new execution lane.
